cards.title: A Neighbor All Along
cards.subtitle: Kenneth Troyer had lived four blocks away

ctaLine: Follow Cold Trail for cases the mainstream forgot
voiceover:
In January nineteen seventy six, police found saliva on a murder victim's body. The killer had kissed her before strangling her to death.

Karen Klaas was a thirty two year old mother, alone in her Hermosa Beach apartment while her son visited his father.

An intruder entered through a window, sexually assaulted and strangled her. He kissed her cheek before leaving.

Detectives preserved the saliva evidence but had no way to analyze it. The case sat cold for twenty two years.

In nineteen ninety eight, DNA technology finally matched the sample to Kenneth Troyer, a neighbor who'd lived four blocks away.

Follow Cold Trail for cases the mainstream forgot.
